product_concept: A focused guide / checklist that helps Account execs running discovery calls run fluid, 20-to-30-minute discovery calls that uncover high-value pain and lock in concrete next steps without making prospects feel grilled.
core_problem: Account execs running discovery calls face a related cluster of problems around conversational 30-min discovery flow & time pacing toolkit — e.g. Insufficient call time to complete thorough discovery and establish next steps, Discovery calls feeling like interrogations rather than natural business conversations.
related_problems: Account Executives struggle to complete effective discovery within standard 30-minute call windows, running out of time before understanding deep buyer pain or setting next steps.
Discovery calls often turn into dynamic interrogations or robotic question checklists, annoying buyers and stalling conversations.
desired_outcome: Run fluid, 20-to-30-minute discovery calls that uncover high-value pain and lock in concrete next steps without making prospects feel grilled.
